Pingat Gagah Perkasa (Tentera) —
(The Conspicuous Gallantry Medal — Military)
Rules 1981
It is hereby notified for general information that the President having been pleased to approve the institution of a medal to be styled the Pingat Gagah Perkasa (Tentera) or “the Conspicuous Gallantry Medal (Military)” hereby makes the following Rules:—

THE SCHEDULE
Rule 4(e)
